the first ever wearable localization device was inkjet-printed directly onto a textile substrate, with the potential to be printed on any other textile substrate.
we have demonstrated for the first time the inkjet-printing of a wearable tracking device on textile, which is compact, lightweight, comfortable, and can be easily hidden under clothes.
we present the first wearable device that can determine the wearer's position by WiFi, which can be printed on a textile.

the realization of a wearable localization device that is compact, lightweight and comfortable to wear, and that can be printed directly on textile.
the realization of a wearable tracking device that can be used for people to track themselves and their belongings.
the design, development and evaluation of a novel, low-cost, and lightweight E-textile based localization device for personal tracking and monitoring applications.

the proposed tracking device is a step towards realizing the full potential of wearable technology.
